text: Given valid instance-url and auth-secret headers, and a session group with active sessions, when screenconnect_get_live_data is called with that group, then it returns the live session list (session_id, name, group_path, is_connected, guest_info) sourced from GetSessionsByFilter.
Given valid headers and a session group with zero active sessions, when screenconnect_get_live_data is called, then it returns an empty list, not an error.

Given a request missing X-ScreenConnect-Auth-Secret, when screenconnect_get_live_data is called, then it returns 401 naming exactly the missing header, and no HTTP request is made to the ScreenConnect instance.

Given the upstream ScreenConnect call returns 401 (secret rejected), when screenconnect_get_live_data is called, then it returns a structured 'auth rejected' error and the secret value never appears in the response or in any log line.

Given the upstream ScreenConnect call returns 404 on the extension path, when screenconnect_get_live_data is called, then it returns a structured 'extension not installed/enabled' error, distinct from the auth-rejected error in TC4.

Given two concurrent calls with different instance-url/auth-secret header pairs, when both are in flight at the same time, then each call's upstream request uses only its own header-supplied credentials -- no credential or response data crosses between the two.
Given a session_group name that does not exist at all on the instance, when screenconnect_get_live_data is called, then it returns an empty list rather than a distinguishable 'group not found' error.
steps: Using a ScreenConnect instance with the RESTful API Manager extension installed and configured, call screenconnect_get_live_data with a session_group value that is not an existing group/folder name on that instance
expect: The tool returns an empty list; it does not raise or return a distinct 'not found' error. This also confirms the Open-questions assumption about GetSessionsByFilter's no-match behavior.
notes: needs a real vendor account (ScreenConnect instance with RESTful API Manager extension installed) -- not a blocker per mcp-track.md 2.5
